status: Independent source-only import-header graph; no Lean import, elaboration, build, package resolution or plugin loading

identity.revision_limit: Commit/tree are retained metadata. Selected cached bytes were checked against the retained manifest; archive bytes were not independently authenticated.

method.module_paths: Resolve each reached Iris.* name under the inner Iris project by replacing dots with slashes and appending .lean. Missing local source is an error.
method.header_parser: Remove nested Lean block comments and line comments while retaining source line numbers and string contents; read the initial import header after optional module/prelude lines. Accept optional public/private/meta modifiers and import all. Read source text only; never evaluate it.
method.completeness_cross_check: Within every reached source, all import-looking lines after comment removal belong to the parsed header; no unparsed import lines were found.
method.edge_semantics: local_edges and external_edges contain distinct directed name pairs. import_declarations separately preserves repeated imports, source line, modifiers and import-all syntax.
method.external_limit: Only direct import names from reached Iris source are recorded. Batteries/Qq/Lean/Std/Init transitive source/object closure and import-time plugins are not resolved.

comparison_with_preparation.legacy_digest_limit: The earlier graph edge list and precise producer schema are not retained in the preparation notes.
